purpose: Acquire and integrity-audit exactly two pinned CoSyn-point train shards for a bounded pointing pilot while leaving the official validation split untouched for possible one-shot confirmation.

dataset_repository.terms_note: Research and educational use under the Ai2 Responsible Use Guidelines; generated assets are also subject to the upstream terms identified by the official dataset card.

blocked_source.reason: Do not download or inspect until a checkpoint and independent confirmation protocol are frozen. The dataset card calls this split unofficial, so any future result is internal confirmation rather than a standard benchmark claim.

transfer.route: Download on the local workstation from the commit-pinned public HTTPS URLs, verify exact byte counts, transfer over the authenticated Tailscale SSH route, then compute SHA256 and inspect parquet metadata on the GPU host.

successor_gate: After both source files pass byte-size, SHA256, exact-schema, within-shard uniqueness, and cross-shard ID-disjointness checks, build only a bounded manifest and fixed visual audit. No training is authorized by this protocol.
claim_boundary: Successful acquisition establishes only source integrity and split disjointness for two shards. It does not establish question quality, point validity, training quality, natural-image transfer, standard benchmark performance, license suitability for a particular product, deployment readiness, novelty, or superiority.
